QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_25

question.text: A Cat III AIF with Rs. 200 crore commitments and 10% hurdle has NAV pre-incentives of Rs. 240 crore after Year 1. Incentive fee rate is 15%. Incentive fees?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook methodology computes incentive fees on the return over the reference hurdle. Reference hurdle = 200 x 1.10 = Rs. 220 crore. Excess over hurdle = 240 - 220 = Rs. 20 crore. Incentive fee at 15% = 0.15 x 20 = Rs. 3 crore. The Trap: Rs. 6 crore doubles the rate to 30%; Rs. 36 crore applies 15% to the full NAV; Rs. 40 crore reports excess return only. Note: Per workbook pages 172-173 and 177.
